t: You're looking at Supernova Heights, a Victorian semi-detached house at 8 Steele's Road in Belsize Park. It is best known as the home of Oasis songwriter Noel Gallagher in the late 1990s, and as a place of non-stop party during those years. The name nods to the Oasis song Champagne Supernova. Gallagher is one of Britain's most successful songwriters, with nine UK number-one singles. The house was later owned by the comedian and writer David Walliams, and by the actress Davinia Taylor, who is known for playing Jude in Hollyoaks.
